key_facts: On April 4, 2023, Plaintiff purchased a 2014 Volvo VNL diesel semi-truck (VIN: 4V4NC9EH6EN142206) from Diamond for $26,900.00 (total charges $27,092.75) with >$12,000 down payment and remaining balance financed by third-party lender. At time of sale, truck suffered a severe DEF/emissions system defect affecting the selective catalytic reduction (SCR) system, rendering it non-compliant with California emissions regulations and unsafe for highway operation. The pleadings allege on information and belief that Diamond concealed and failed to disclose: (1) the emissions defect; (2) the truck's regulatory non-compliance; (3) a prior owner's written or verbal disclosure of the DEF system failure and engine derate condition before resale; and (4) a California enforcement agency out-of-service designation. The prior-owner disclosure and enforcement designation remain unconfirmed and subject to investigation and discovery. Shortly after purchase while operating under Lease-On Owner Operator Agreement, truck experienced catastrophic emissions failure, entered 'limp mode,' emitted excessive black smoke, became incapable of exceeding approximately 35 mph, rendering it commercially unusable and unsafe. Plaintiff unable to mitigate by renting/purchasing replacement vehicle due to capital exhaustion. Per the Declaration in Support of Default Judgment (Attachment 4b to the July 20, 2026 CM-110 Case Management Statement), documented out-of-pocket losses total $20,218.65: deposit (Retail Buyer's Order) $12,345.10; GAP Addendum enrollment $1,895.00; CA DMV fees $3,442.00 (billed, outstanding, penalties accruing); Brannon Tire (emergency tire/road service) $1,197.34; Mobile Will's Truck/Auto Repair Shop $740.00; Golden Empire Towing, Inc. $562.50; Western Truck Center (lamp/parts) $36.71. Additional undocumented out-of-pocket losses (sworn testimony, no receipt) total $5,750.00: Commercial Towing (CVC §22852 storage release) $750.00; Almaraz Diesel (DEF/SCR diagnostic and repair) $5,000.00. Lost commercial income for the default prove-up is conservatively calculated at $23,400.00 (18 weeks × $1,300/week) — a deliberately conservative sworn figure distinct from the broader >$46,800 projected lost-income theory pursued against both defendants at trial. Prejudgment interest under Civ. Code §3287(a) (7%, ~3.04 years) adds $4,302.55, for a compensatory subtotal of $53,671.20, plus $25,000.00 in punitive damages under Civ. Code §3294 — a default judgment prove-up total of not less than $78,671.20 plus costs of suit, sought against Diamond alone.
